title: Inspection evidence review
boundary: Matches the supplied inspection records, supporting materials and unit scores. This does not verify field inspection authenticity, organizational responsibilities or signatures, and does not replace deliverable review or an independent numerical check.
scopeLimit: Select all 1–8 units from one initial sample and their existing planar-control-point or height-control-section scores. This review does not determine whether a sample or batch passes acceptance.
offline: The survey service is not connected. Reading and saving are temporarily unavailable.
cancelled: Waiting cancelled. Saving may still complete; check the saved records before trying again.
planSummary: Target units and supporting materials are fixed. Choose their score records to continue.
counts: Expected {{expectedUnits}} · Linked scores {{linkedScores}} · Full unit results {{fullProfileUnits}} · Retained mappings {{satisfiedMaterialMappings}}/{{requiredMaterialMappings}} · Unresolved references {{unresolvedReferences}}
existingAssociation: The existing score is associated with this unit as declared; the association has not been independently verified
exportFailed: Export failed; saving was not confirmed.
frozenPlan: Confirmed evidence plan (units and materials cannot be overwritten)
scoreSelectionHint: Choose the matching existing score for each unit. A missing score remains marked as incomplete. If records are temporarily unavailable, wait a moment and try again.
loadRetention: Load retention plans for this deliverable
previousAssessmentRequired: Select the exact assessment from the immediately previous round before confirming this plan.
previousAssessmentSelected: Previous assessment matches the prior sampling record and its source record.
scoreReasonUnavailable: Professional scoring reason is unavailable in this record.
reference: Evidence reference used in the score
acknowledge: I confirm that all selected units and their supporting materials are included. This confirms the associations only; material completeness, field inspection authenticity, inspection completion and professional approval still require review.
savedOnly: These are saved results. Opening a record rechecks its source materials.

states.complete-full-profile-unit-results: Every target has a full-profile unit result
states.incomplete-full-profile-unit-results: Unit results missing, partial or unavailable

errors.validation: Check that every selected unit is included in the original order and matched to the correct materials and score.
errors.not-found: Source missing or outside this project.
errors.stale: Project or deliverable changed; reload sources and create a new plan.
errors.integrity: The saved record does not match the source materials or the check calculation. Resolve the difference before continuing.
errors.conflict: This save conflicts with an existing plan. The original record is retained; open it to review or create a new plan.
errors.source-changed: Source materials have changed. The original assessment is retained; create a new assessment using the current materials.
errors.unsupported-scope: Include all 1–8 units from one initial sample. Each unit name must be no longer than 160 characters.
errors.limit: The current capacity limit has been reached. Check available storage and reduce the amount processed at once.
errors.rate-limit: Records have been opened too frequently. Wait one minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Evidence review is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.replay-environment: The original calculation conditions cannot be reproduced. The saved record is unchanged and needs further review.
errors.invalid-response: The returned record could not be matched to the selected materials. It cannot be treated as verified; open it again or check the source materials.
errors.request-failed: Completion could not be confirmed. Check saved records or try again.
